en: The image is a black and white photograph of a public square featuring a prominent statue of a man in a cloak standing on a pedestal. In the background, there is an ornate building with a large clock above its entrance. Trees and a fence surround the square, and a person is seen standing by a tree in the foreground. The handwritten text at the top reads: 'Pécs: Kossuth szobor.'
